commit 9bb02a6f3a109e628b9457b788c43b727f85a1fc
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 8 14:14:53 2025 +0000
Commit:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 8 14:14:53 2025 +0000

    Bug 1968470 - Remove 'Copy Message Location' from mail context menu. r=aleca
    
    
    This removes the option to get the exact 'news:' URL (including server and
    port) for newsgroup messages, which has been relocated in some form to
    header pane's 'More actions' menu button.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D254403

diff --git a/mail/base/content/mailContext.inc.xhtml b/mail/base/content/mailContext.inc.xhtml
index 0bbf9d18169..fe120563e29 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/mailContext.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/base/content/mailContext.inc.xhtml
@@ -297,10 +297,6 @@
           data-l10n-attrs="accesskey">
       <menupopup id="mailContext-organizePopup"
                  class="no-icon-menupopup">
-        <menuitem id="mailContext-copyMessageUrl"
-                  class="menuitem-iconic"
-                  label="&copyMessageLocation.label;"
-                  accesskey="&copyMessageLocation.accesskey;"/>
         <menuitem id="mailContext-archive"
                   class="menuitem-iconic"
                   label="&contextArchive.label;"
diff --git a/mail/base/content/mailContext.js b/mail/base/content/mailContext.js
index 4e28ac1592b..9fd5ffc291c 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/mailContext.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/mailContext.js
@@ -414,7 +414,6 @@ var mailContextMenu = {
 
     checkItem("mailContext-markFlagged", message?.isFlagged);
 
-    setSingleSelection("mailContext-copyMessageUrl", !!isNewsgroup);
     // Disable move if we can't delete message(s) from this folder.
     showItem("mailContext-moveMenu", canMove && !onSpecialItem);
     showItem("mailContext-copyMenu", canCopy && !onSpecialItem);
@@ -660,24 +659,6 @@ var mailContextMenu = {
 
       // Move/copy/archive/convert/delete
       // (Move and Copy sub-menus are handled in the default case.)
-      case "mailContext-copyMessageUrl": {
-        const message = gDBView.hdrForFirstSelectedMessage;
-        const server = message?.folder?.server;
-
-        if (!server) {
-          return;
-        }
-
-        // TODO let backend construct URL and return as attribute
-        let url =
-          server.socketType == Ci.nsMsgSocketType.SSL ? "snews://" : "news://";
-        url += server.hostName + ":" + server.port + "/" + message.messageId;
-
-        Cc["@mozilla.org/widget/clipboardhelper;1"]
-          .getService(Ci.nsIClipboardHelper)
-          .copyString(url);
-        break;
-      }
 
       // Calendar Convert sub-menu
       case "mailContext-calendar-convert-event-menuitem":
diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/browser_mailContext.js b/mail/base/test/browser/browser_mailContext.js
index 2308e79a6fc..199fb4d0154 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/browser_mailContext.js
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/browser_mailContext.js
@@ -210,7 +210,6 @@ const mailContextData = {
   "mailContext-markAsNotJunk": notExternal,
   "mailContext-recalculateJunkScore": notExternal,
   "mailContext-organize": notExternal,
-  "mailContext-copyMessageUrl": [],
   "mailContext-archive": notExternal,
   "mailContext-decryptToFolder": [
     "multipleMessagesTree",
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messenger.dtd b/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messenger.dtd
index b745a992eb4..47a2d79bf7e 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messenger.dtd
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messenger.dtd
@@ -351,8 +351,6 @@
 <!ENTITY moveMsgToMenu.accesskey "M">
 <!ENTITY moveCopyMsgRecentMenu.label "Recent">
 <!ENTITY moveCopyMsgRecentMenu.accesskey "R">
-<!ENTITY copyMessageLocation.label "Copy Message Location">
-<!ENTITY copyMessageLocation.accesskey "M">
 <!ENTITY copyMsgToMenu.label "Copy To">
 <!ENTITY copyMsgToMenu.accesskey "C">
 <!ENTITY moveToFolderAgain.label "Move Again">
